analysis.title_zh: TorchNeuron 性能剖析（第一部分）：AWS Trainium 上的系统级性能分析
analysis.summary: 本文是面向零性能剖析经验读者的系列首篇，介绍如何系统分析推理性能、定位时间消耗，而非宣布新版本发布。示例采用 AWS Trainium 与其开源原生 PyTorch 后端 TorchNeuron。原文说明，该后端支持即时执行、torch.compile 和标准 PyTorch API，仅需少量代码修改。适用于推理耗时诊断与性能瓶颈分析；所给资料已截断，未呈现具体操作或性能测试结果。
analysis.application: 建议：科研迁移可考虑将系统级耗时分析用于智能运维模型的推理瓶颈诊断，作为优化前的测量环节；这属于迁移设想，并非本文已验证结论。官方提供的片段说明了工作流支持与教程目标，未给出已验证的加速幅度或科研任务效果。
evidence: In Part 1 of this series, you will learn how to systematically analyze inference performance and identify where the time is spent.
This post starts from scratch and assumes no prior profiling experience.
The walkthrough uses AWS Trainium, a purpose-built AI chip for deep learning training and inference workloads, and TorchNeuron , its open source native PyTorch backend.
TorchNeuron supports standard PyTorch workflows on Trainium, including eager execution, torch.compile , and standard PyTorch APIs, with minimal code changes.
